snippet.title: Imperiums: Greek Wars announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Historical 4X turn-based strategy game set in time of Philip II of Macedon.

Imperiums: Greek Wars is a unique combination of turn-based 4X and historical grand strategy with a mythological twist. Explore the ancient world and open it up to your people. Survive, expand, conquer... and win!
You can buy the game here https://imperiumsgame.com/purchase/
or on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1183470/Imperiums_Greek_Wars
Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1183470/discussions/
